response.sql: WITH country_averages AS (SELECT p.death_country, AVG(pav.points_won) as avg_points_won FROM player_award_vote pav JOIN player p ON pav.player_id = p.player_id WHERE pav.points_won IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.death_country), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_points_won) as overall_avg FROM country_averages) SELECT ca.death_country, ca.avg_points_won, ca.avg_points_won - oa.overall_avg as difference_from_average FROM country_averages ca CROSS JOIN overall_average oa ORDER BY ca.death_country
